description:
Terms used to specify items to return in an aggregation data response. 
In practice we use the the `id` field from existing filtering terms and avoid
the additional modifiers, but addditionally allows the use of custom summary
structures beyond aggregaion corresponding to query filters; e.g.
* a `survivalGroups` term could aggregate data by survival groups
* a `cnvfrequencies` term could envoke a list of objects for gain, loss, ...
  events per genomic interval in the matched data
Note: Alphanumeric filters usually would be used in form of a full stringified
expression, e.g. `sexAtBirth:=female` to allow counts on this specific value.
title: Aggregation Terms
